name: Priscilla Barielle
japaneseName: プリシラ・バーリエル
description: Priscilla Barielle, born Prisca Benedict, is an exiled imperial princess of the Sacred Vollachia Empire, the Matriarch of House Barielle, and a candidate in Lugunica's Royal Selection. Endowed with incomparable haughtiness, fierce charisma, and absolute conviction that the world turns in her favor, she stands as a central figure throughout Arc 3, Arc 5, and especially the Vollachian campaigns in Arc 7 and Arc 8.
